task: Export the Part::Sphere named 'Sphere' (Radius=30) from /home/user/Documents/ball.FCStd to an STL file at /home/user/exports/ball.stl. The resulting STL must have at least 200 triangles. Save the FCStd document after exporting.
task_grounding: FreeCAD is open with /home/user/Documents/ball.FCStd. The document contains a single Part::Sphere named 'Sphere' with Radius=30. Click 'Sphere' in the Model tree to select it. Use File > Export to save it as an 'STL Mesh (*.stl)'. In the file save dialog, navigate to /home/user/exports/ (create that folder if it does not exist) and set the filename to exactly 'ball.stl'. Click Save. Because a sphere tessellates into many triangles, the resulting STL must have at least 200 triangles (FreeCAD's default mesh deviation produces well over that for a 30 mm sphere, so the default settings are fine). After exporting, return to FreeCAD and press Ctrl+S to save the FCStd document.
